title: Conference kit and expense tracker
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for the upcoming developer summit (three days). Mostly admin + receipts + vendor contacts. Not a formal doc — notes-to-self.

Trip summary:
- Conference: DevOps & AI Summit 2026 (expo + 2-day workshop)
- Dates: 2026-03-20 (travel out) — 2026-03-24 (travel back)
- Location: Portland Convention Center, downtown
- Goal: demos for Redwood Optimize + collect benchmarking leads, set up 1:1s with 4 partner vendors

High-level schedule (rough):
- 3/20: flight in, quick check-in at AirBnB, sling demo laptop build (install last-minute deps)
- 3/21: booth set-up 7am; morning expo; speaker session 2pm (15 min)
- 3/22: workshops all day; partner dinners 7pm
- 3/23: follow-ups, rip down booth 4pm, evening travel optional

Packing checklist (dev/devops kit):
- [ ] Primary laptop (M1 Pro) + charger + spare USB-C
- [ ] Demo machine (NVIDIA dev box) — checklist for GPU image snapshot (make sure kernel patched)
- [ ] HDMI adapter, ethernet dongle, travel AP (if unstable wifi)
- [ ] USB keys (bootable images), power strip, label maker (booth)
- [ ] Printed business cards (30) + sponsor one-pagers (10)
- [ ] Receipts envelope (paper) + phone photos of receipts (backup)

Expense reminders / reimbursement notes:
- Company card used for: booth fee, catering (partner dinner), rental AP, taxis > $30 — keep itemized receipts.
- Personal card used for: flights + extra hotel nights — will submit for reimbursement (JIRA-INC-4123).
- Per diem: $60/day (breakfast/lunch/dinner) — track meals separately; mark meals with partner names for partner-meal rule.
- Taxis / rideshare: include screenshots of receipts + trip IDs.
- VAT / foreign transaction: N/A (domestic).
- Expense codes to use in Concur: TRVL-CONF-2026, MKT-BOOTH-DEV
- Expense submission deadline: 2026-04-05 (30 days from end of travel)

Receipt handling protocol (quick):
- At end of each day: gather paper receipts -> scan with phone (Notes app) -> upload to Drive folder (path: shared_drives/company/events/DevOpsAI-Summit-2026/receipts) -> label filename: vendor-YYYYMMDD-amount
- If vendor gave invoice: ask for PDF via email and add to linked artifacts.

Booth + vendor logistics (contacts & quick notes):
- Booth contact (venue logistics): Daniela Ortiz, Portland Events Co. — daniela@portlandevents.co / +1-503-555-0142 — crate arrival window 6:30-7:30am (confirm day before)
- AV/AV tech (onsite): Marco Alvarez — marco@eventav.io / +1-503-555-0177 — bring HDMI & backup laptop for local media playback
- Catering (partner dinner): Willow Catering (point: Cameron Lee) — cameron@willowcatering.com / invoice to Finance after event; estimate $420 for 12 people
- Rental WiFi / AP: RentNet Solutions — orders@rentnet.io / order #RN-2219; contact: Nina Patel +1-415-555-0201
- Booth install crew recommended (if we need help): BuildFast LLC — lead: Chris Monroe chris@buildfast.com / quote pending

Partner meeting notes (to prep before 1:1s):
- VertexAI Partners — ask about model quantization tradeoffs for gated customers; bring latency bench script (script: bench/latency-client-v2)
- EdgeAccel Hardware — confirm support for INT8 on T4-like hardware; ask about packaging for Dedicated customers
- DataLock KMS — compliance questions: HSM integration timelines + audit log retention options

Action items (personal):
- [ ] Confirm booth crate arrival window with Daniela (email today)
- [ ] Upload proof of insurance for booth to Confluence (CONFLUENCE-9876)
- [ ] Finalize slide deck + rehearse 2x with Liam (slot 3/19 10am PT)
- [ ] Print one-pager for partner handouts (Maya to review copy)
- [ ] Create expense folder in Drive + pre-create subfolders by date
- [ ] Add backup demo container to USB key (tag = demo-2026-03-20)

Unresolved / questions to ask ops/event team:
- - Do we get complimentary lead-scanner or do we rent? (cost center?)
- - Who owns booth insurance for accidental damage? (Finance or Events budget?)
- - Is there a dedicated storage room overnight or do we need to take everything back to Airbnb each night?

Quick cheatsheet for onsite finance (to hand to admin if needed):
- Make sure invoices list Redwood Inference as billed entity; include PO if needed (PO# RF-2026-034)
- If vendor issues a physical invoice at booth, ask them to email PDF to finance@redwood-inference.com and cc me (aisha@redwood-inference.com)

Notes-to-self (log-style):
- Don’t forget extra SIM for travel AP (rentnet sometimes drops); pack ethernet cable and test before leaving.
- Keep demo credentials on 1Password note tagged "dev-summit-2026" and share with Liam + Maya with expiration 2026-03-25.
- Take 10 live lead demos to validate streaming latency; capture sample ids for follow-up.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into formal post-mortem doc after travel.
